hero.name: Daniel Serna
hero.title: Software Engineer — Fullstack Development
hero.description: I build production-grade fullstack applications — from NestJS backends and PostgreSQL schemas to React/Next.js web platforms and React Native mobile apps, with a strong focus on IoT integrations and security.

about.title: About Me
about.content: Software Engineer with 4+ years of fullstack experience building NestJS/Node.js backends, React/Next.js web platforms, and React Native mobile apps with IoT integrations. End-to-end ownership from PostgreSQL schema design and REST API architecture through client-side delivery, with production deployments serving enterprise platforms and mobile clients. Strong background in cryptographic systems, real-time applications, and cross-platform development with emphasis on performance and security.

penteon.short: Enterprise mobile and web platform serving 500+ daily active users across Mexico.
penteon.developed1: Designed and shipped a React Native mobile app and Next.js enterprise platform serving 500+ daily active users across Mexico.
penteon.developed2: Architected a cross-platform IoT monitoring application (React Native + Expo) with biometric authentication, APNs/FCM push notifications, real-time device state management, reducing field service visits by 30%.
penteon.developed3: Led frontend engineering for an enterprise web platform (Next.js 15, React 18) delivering role-based dashboards, asset management, work orders, and billing — using React Query, Zustand, and Framer Motion.
penteon.developed4: Enforced engineering standards across 650+ commits: >96% TypeScript coverage, ESLint/Prettier with Husky pre-commit hooks, structured peer code review reducing bugs in production by 25%.

soltec.short: Web development using Vue 3 across 6+ product modules.
soltec.developed1: Built Vue 3 SPA modules with Pinia state management across 6+ product modules, eliminating duplicated API requests and improving component synchronization efficiency by 40%.
soltec.developed2: Implemented AG Grid data tables for high-volume operational views integrating Naive UI component library with custom theming.
soltec.developed3: Co-designed REST API data contracts and authentication flows (JWT + role-based access) with backend engineers, reducing integration rework by 35%.
soltec.developed4: Optimized bundle size by 28% through code-splitting and lazy loading strategies, improving initial load times for enterprise clients.
